method: MP2019 land-use polygons (columns LU_DESC, LU_TEXT, GPR, OBJECTID) transformed to EPSG:3414, made valid, intersected with the Queenstown planning-area polygon (planar, sf_use_s2(FALSE)); only polygon parts kept; slivers of 1 m2 or less dropped; area_m2 is the clipped area.
purpose: Queenstown land-use zoning for workplace and amenity placement.
